Fourth governed DeepSeek review of head c6feced1 ended with an unrecordable verdict (its private response drafted REVISE on four narrow items: start-date-changed semantics, company null-safety, invalid-index recovery, deparse-literal comparison); all four fixed in a later implementation commit.
